EFC-R01-repository-reads-tracking-identi.meaning: Repository/read-query behavior: tracking, identity map, AsNoTrackingWithIdentityResolution, partial init anti-patterns, Load/Find/AutoInclude, and read/write fetch discipline.

EFC-R02-entities-constructors-attach-sha.meaning: Entity lifecycle and EF materialization: constructors, parameterless ctor behavior, Attach/detached entities, shadow properties, and config/model rules around domain entities.

EFC-R04-transactions-concurrency-executi.meaning: Transactions/concurrency/execution strategies: rowversion/concurrency tokens, isolation, reading own changes, retry strategies, transaction patterns, rollback notes.

EFC-R05-db-invariants-exceptions-error-h.meaning: Database invariants and exceptions: SQL Server error codes, concurrency exceptions, retry exception handling, original values/database values, ETags, and DB-level invariant handling.
